content: {"episode_id":"ep-05146","cpt":"93226","denial_carc":"CO-22","necessity_paragraph":"Medical necessity review is requested for CPT 93226, the 48-hour Holter monitoring study ordered for recurrent dizziness and transient loss of consciousness in the context of known sick sinus syndrome.
